Why we're doing this

Technology is moving faster than most of us can keep up with. We feel it too.

More apps. More accounts. More updates. More setup. Somewhere along the way, simple things got harder, and talking to the people in the room got pushed aside by the screens in our hands.

We come from very different places: AI agent research at MIT, AI powered advertising at Google, and 18 years of delivery inside banking. But we kept coming back to the same question.

Can we make something a 10-year-old, or a grandma, can set up and use without any help?

That's what we're developing at v/h: everyday devices that do one useful job, with the clever part kept inside. Our requirements are simple. No app to download, no account to create and no subscription for the core job. You should be able to switch it on and use it.
